data.one_liner: Convert any Flutter widget into a Google Maps BitmapDescriptor for marker icons.
data.what_it_does: The package adds an extension that renders a widget to an image and creates a BitmapDescriptor. This allows custom widgets, including text and images, to be used as map markers.
use_when: You need custom marker icons beyond static images
You want to display dynamic data or text on map markers
You prefer a Flutter‑only solution without native drawing code
avoid_when: Performance is critical for thousands of markers
You need offline rendering without a Flutter UI context
strengths: Supports logical and image size control
Works on Android, iOS, and web
weaknesses: May be slower for large or many markers
Relies on widget rendering which can fail for complex widgets
